Traditional search remains critical, but discovery now also happens through AI search, large language models, coding assistants, technical communities, and other third-party sources. Apryse must understand where we appear across these channels, why competitors may outrank or outperform us, and what we need to do to improve.

As an SEO Specialist, you will analyze Apryse’s organic search presence and broader developer-discovery footprint, identify the gaps that matter most, and translate your findings into prioritized actions. You will combine traditional SEO analysis with emerging answer engine optimization practices to help Apryse earn greater visibility across search engines and AI-generated answers.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys moving from research to recommendations to measurable results. You will work closely with the SEO Manager, AEO Program Manager, Content Writers, web team, and other marketing partners to turn data into content and website improvements that drive qualified traffic, conversions, and pipeline.

Responsibilities

Analyze Organic Search Performance

  • Monitor and analyze Apryse’s organic search performance across products, use cases, industries, and priority developer queries.

  • Identify changes in rankings, impressions, click-through rates, organic traffic, conversion, and competitive visibility.

  • Conduct keyword, query, content-gap, and search-intent research to identify new opportunities and areas of underperformance.

  • Assess existing content to determine where pages should be created, updated, consolidated, repositioned, or retired.

  • Build recurring reports that explain performance, identify causes, and recommend next actions.

  • Connect search performance to downstream outcomes, including conversions, MQLs, SAOs, pipeline, and bookings.

Conduct Competitive and Market Research

  • Analyze how competitors appear across traditional search, AI-generated answers, coding assistants, and developer-focused discovery channels.

  • Evaluate competitor content strategies, topic coverage, rankings, citations, backlinks, page structures, and organic footprint.

  • Identify the content, technical, authority, and positioning factors influencing Apryse’s visibility.

  • Monitor changes in search behaviour, competitor activity, algorithms, and developer-discovery patterns.

  • Translate research into clear opportunities for Apryse to strengthen its coverage, authority, and differentiation.

Turn Insights Into Action

  • Convert research findings into a prioritized, actionable backlog for the Developer Experience Pod and broader Marketing team.

  • Develop SEO briefs that define the target audience, search intent, primary queries, content gaps, competitive considerations, and recommended page structure.

  • Clearly distinguish between quick wins, foundational improvements, and longer-term opportunities.

  • Partner with Developer Writers and other content creators to ensure deliverables address the identified search and discoverability gaps.

  • Review completed content and web updates to confirm that recommendations have been implemented effectively.

  • Track the impact of completed work and use the results to refine future priorities.

Support AI and Answer Engine Visibility

  • Monitor how AI search platforms and large language models surface, describe, cite, or omit Apryse.

  • Identify priority questions and prompts where Apryse should be included but is absent, inaccurately represented, or positioned behind competitors.

  • Analyze the sources, content patterns, and third-party signals associated with stronger visibility in AI-generated answers.

  • Partner with the AEO Program Manager to turn findings into content, technical, and off-site recommendations.

  • Track AI share of voice, mention rate, citation rate, average position, and positioning accuracy across priority topics.

  • Help the organization build a repeatable understanding of how traditional SEO and answer engine optimization work together.

Support On-Page and Technical SEO

  • Conduct on-page reviews covering titles, headings, internal linking, metadata, schema, content structure, indexability, and search intent.

  • Identify technical SEO issues that may limit crawling, indexing, page performance, or organic visibility.

  • Partner with web and development teams to document issues, recommend solutions, and validate completed changes.

  • Support internal-linking and site-architecture improvements that help users and search engines understand the relationships between Apryse products, capabilities, documentation, and supporting content.

  • Maintain SEO standards and guidance for content creators and website stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in SEO, organic growth, content strategy, or a closely related role.

  • Strong working knowledge of keyword research, competitive analysis, content optimization, on-page SEO, internal linking, and technical SEO fundamentals.

  • Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or comparable platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to interpret search and website data, identify meaningful patterns, and recommend specific actions.

  • Experience producing clear, actionable SEO briefs and recommendations for writers, marketers, designers, and web teams.

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with how AI search platforms and large language models discover, synthesize, and cite online information—or a strong interest in developing that expertise quickly.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple research, reporting, and optimization priorities.

  • A results-oriented mindset with an interest in connecting organic performance to conversions, pipeline, and revenue.

Skills & Mindset

  • You are naturally curious and want to understand why something is happening—not simply report that it happened.

  • You can turn a large amount of search, content, and competitive data into a focused set of priorities.

  • You distinguish between activity metrics and business impact and care about both visibility and conversion.

  • You can communicate recommendations clearly enough that another team can act on them without additional interpretation.

  • You are comfortable working in an evolving discipline where the established SEO playbook is expanding to include AI search and answer engines.

  • You balance attention to detail with the judgment to focus on the opportunities most likely to produce meaningful results.

  • You are collaborative, self-directed, and comfortable working across content, web, product marketing, and technical teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working for an SDK, API, developer-tools, infrastructure, or technical B2B software company.

jobs.description:
Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and achieved Unicorn status in 2024.
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.
If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most!

The role

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering team responsible for Scheduling, one of the most heavily used parts of Deputy. You will lead and grow engineers with a range of experience while helping the team make sound technical decisions and deliver meaningful improvements for customers.

Deputy powers hourly work for more than 1.5 million shift workers across 380,000 workplaces in over 100 countries. Businesses have used the platform to create more than a billion shifts. At the heart of this is Scheduling, where business demand, employee availability, labour costs and compliance come together.

The role combines the complexity of a mature, business-critical product with the opportunity to improve its foundations and shape what comes next. The team is modernising established workflows, improving performance for larger customers and exploring where AI can make scheduling simpler and more effective.

This is a technical engineering leadership role. You will develop a strong understanding of the product and architecture so you can contribute to technical discussions, coach senior engineers and help the team make pragmatic trade-offs. During your first few months, you will spend some time in the codebase and may contribute targeted changes as part of learning the product. Over time, your greatest impact will come through the performance and growth of the team.

What you will do

    Lead the team

  • Set clear expectations, give useful feedback and coach engineers through their growth, performance and career development.

  • Build a team culture where people can challenge ideas, learn from mistakes and hold a high bar for each other.

  • Create clarity when priorities change, surface risks early and help the team maintain a predictable delivery cadence.

  • Hire thoughtfully as the team grows and reduce single points of failure through cross-skilling and deliberate resourcing decisions.

    • Shape the technical direction

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Scheduling product and its architecture so you can contribute meaningfully to technical decisions.

  • Work with senior engineers to set technical direction and make clear decisions about architecture, frameworks and build-versus-buy trade-offs.

  • Guide improvements to the performance, reliability, security and maintainability of a multi-tenant product used by businesses around the world.

  • Stay close to the engineering work through design reviews, architecture discussions, incident learning and targeted proofs of concept.

    • Deliver customer and business outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product, Design and Data to turn strategy and customer problems into a focused roadmap with measurable outcomes.

  • Balance near-term customer value with the technical investment needed to keep Scheduling fast, dependable and ready for enterprise scale.

  • Keep the team connected to Deputy's goals and explain the context behind priorities and trade-offs.

    • Help evolve how we build with AI

  • Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools on real work and form your own view of where they help and where they do not.

  • Help the team develop effective working practices for machine-drafted code, including review, testing, observability and documentation.

  • Maintain the quality bar by ensuring that what ships is correct, secure, maintainable and understood by the people who own it.

  • When the team contributes to customer-facing AI, work with Product and Engineering on evaluation, guardrails, cost, latency and graceful failure.

What we are looking for

    Must haves

  • Experience leading engineers, whether as an Engineering Manager or a senior engineer who has taken responsibility for technical direction, delivery and the growth of others. We are open to experienced managers and lead engineers looking to move into their first formal management role.

  • Strong technical judgement. You can engage deeply in design discussions, challenge assumptions and explain engineering decisions to technical and non-technical leaders.

  • Experience delivering and operating customer-facing software, including making trade-offs between delivery speed, reliability and long-term maintainability.

  • A track record of developing engineers through clear expectations, regular feedback and thoughtful coaching.

  • Experience partnering with Product and Design to shape priorities and deliver outcomes, rather than treating engineering as a queue of work.

  • First-hand experience with AI development tools. Your opinions are informed by using them, and you can review their output critically.

  • The ability to create momentum in ambiguous situations by identifying constraints, bringing the right people together and making practical decisions.

    • Nice to haves

  • Building and operating distributed, cloud-native or multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale.

  • Designing for resilience across services, event-driven systems and large relational or NoSQL data stores.

  • Shipping LLM-backed or agentic capabilities in production.

  • Working on workforce management, scheduling or another operationally complex product.

    • Technology experience

    We use a mix of languages and tooling, including PHP, Go, Python building on top of AWS. We care more about your technical depth, judgement and ability to learn than an exact match with our current stack.

Employee Perks

  • Join our global working groups focused on collaboration, belonging and connection

  • Take advantage of our novated leasing for electric vehicles, internet reimbursement and more!

Every CodePath learner engages our platform, whether they are a college CS student in a direct course, a student at a partner university, an alum sharpening their skills, or a working engineer retraining for the AI era. The Senior Product Manager, Learner Platform Experience owns this platform.

As we grow from tens of thousands of learners toward millions, the quality and effectiveness of the learner experience on the platform has to improve, not dilute. Director, Field Translational Science — Oncology

Position Summary

Natera is shifting disease management worldwide through unprecedented molecular innovation. As the Director of Field Translational Science, you will build, scale, and lead a specialized team of field-facing translational scientists within our Oncology Business Unit. This high-autonomy leadership role is designed for a strategic builder who can run a sophisticated regional team while serving as the executive authority for advanced Natera tests - including, but not limited to, cell-free DNA (cfDNA) and minimal residual disease (MRD) assays - and their associated data analysis frameworks across elite academic medical centers.

This position requires up to 50-70% regional travel to engage with institutional leadership and audit high-priority research partnerships. You will eliminate the standard boundaries between field data generation and internal pipeline design. Distinct from traditional, education-focused Medical Affairs teams (MSLs), your organization owns the structural integrity, statistical validation, and scientific output of investigator-led data collaborations.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Scale: Hire, develop, and manage a premier field organization of translational scientists, establishing clear performance metrics tied to regional data velocity, scientific rigor, and publication quality.
  • Strategic Data Architecture: Author and execute the regional data engagement strategy, guiding how field scientists partner with oncologists, pathologists, and biometricians to unlock complex ctDNA and real-world datasets; holds the institutional/enterprise escalation line for the direct day-to-day communication line with the clinicians.
  • Regional Operations & Systems Governance: Oversee the secure regional tracking architecture and data ingestion pipelines that individual Field Translational Scientists operate within; ensure absolute data compliance, system integrity, and streamlined data flow from investigator sites into internal analysis platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Governance: Command the interface between field operations and internal Oncology Translational Medicine & Scientific Communications, Medical Affairs, Life Cycle, R&D and Product Development leadership, translating field-derived real-world evidence into high-impact pipeline recommendations.
  • Investigator-Led Portfolio Management: In partnership with MSLs, oversee the lifecycle of all regional investigator-initiated trials (IITs) and institutional registries, ensuring team members enable investigators to maximize the utility of Natera’s proprietary analytical tools and data visualization platforms to achieve statistical robustness and prompt manuscript generation.
  • Institutional Network Expansion: Secure, scale, and manage institutional data-sharing models, biobanking governance, and EMR data-integration initiatives with core comprehensive cancer networks.
  • Scientific Advocacy & Compliance: Represent Natera as a senior scientific authority at major oncology congresses, ensuring all field data-handling methods maintain absolute alignment with HIPAA, CAP/CLIA, PHI data protocols, FDA regulations, and PhRMA codes of interaction.

Qualifications

  • Required Education: PhD or MD in Cancer Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, or a related complex molecular science discipline.
  • Required Experience: 6+ years of total experience within basic or translational oncology research, including a minimum of 2+ years of explicit people management experience leading high-performing scientific or clinical teams within the diagnostics, biotechnology or pharmaceutical sectors.
  • Domain Mastery: Exceptional command of cancer biology and genetics, liquid biopsy modalities and clinical utilities, next-generation sequencing (NGS) and ctDNA workflows and data interpretation, and statistical methods.
  • Data-Centric Track Record: Documented success managing complex genomic datasets, institutional electronic medical record (EMR) integrations, or complex clinical data registries.
  • Leadership Style: Proven ability to manage teams through high ambiguity, prioritizing structured logic and rapid, high-judgment decision-making over consensus-driven delays.
  • Operational Mobility: Ability and willingness to travel domestically up to 50-70% to support team execution, site audits, and principal investigator collaborations.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health.   • Applying data-centric ML methods such as hard-example mining, resampling/reweighting and curriculum or balance adjustments to lift model performance.

Required

  • Proficiency in Python (NumPy/Pandas or equivalent dataframe tooling) with experience in Linux environments.

Desirable

  • Proficiency in Go or C++.
  • Familiarity with experiment tracking and evaluation tooling such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or in-house equivalents.
  • Familiarity with statistical methods for A/B comparison, regression detection and noisy-metric analysis.
  • Familiarity with data mining and curation at scale (embedding-based retrieval, active learning, auto-labeling).
  • Familiarity with visualization and dashboarding tools (Plotly, Grafana, Streamlit or similar).

    • Prolonged sitting
    • Prolonged standing
    • Prolonged computer use

Travel required? - Low 5-10%

  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.

jobs.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We’re inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations.

Business Development Managers (BDMs) play a critical role in creating early-stage pipeline and advancing opportunities within enterprise provider accounts. This role bridges marketing-generated demand (“MQL”) and sales-driven evaluations by owning the motions that move opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and later, as they ramp up, Discovery → Evaluation in partnership with AVPs.

The BDMs will engage in omnichannel lead generation—email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling—to activate cold or stalled accounts, warm target personas, and secure meaningful early conversations. They will partner closely with AVPs to tailor account-based programs for priority systems, execute targeted plays using solution-specific Sales Playbooks, and ensure exit criteria are met to progress opportunities.

This individual partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to gather discovery insights, build relationship maps, capture exit-criteria–aligned intel, and drive early traction that sets AVPs up for success.

This is a high-impact, visible role for someone who is persistent, operationally excellent, highly organized, and comfortable navigating complex provider organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Opportunity Advancement (Primary Focus)

  • Own the early-stage advancement of opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and as proficiency grows, Discovery → Evaluation.
  • Execute solution-specific Sales Playbooks to ensure all exit criteria are met before handoff.
  • Capture and document discovery answers (via email, prep, or call notes) to support progression.
  • Execute warm handoffs of qualified opportunities to AVPs with complete and accurate context.

Omnichannel Outbound & Lead Generation

  • Run multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling to activate early interest and secure meetings.
  • Engage cold accounts or pre-qualified accounts to generate first conversations for AVPs from Ideal Customer Persona (ICP) accounts
  • Conduct inbound lead triage and fast follow-up for prospects engaging with marketing assets or events.
  • Call clinical and operational office lines or executive assistants to schedule meetings and coordinate access.

Account-Based Engagement & Territory Support

  • Partner with AVPs to tailor account-specific ABM plays using provided templates and messaging frameworks.
  • Customize persona-based outreach sequences and messaging for specific territories and strategic accounts.
  • Maintain and continuously refine Sales Navigator filters to ensure the right personas and accounts stay in focus.
  • Build and maintain relationship maps at the opportunity and account level to track influence, organizational structure, and decision pathways.
  • Ensure all relevant contacts are captured, enriched, and updated within Salesforce.
  • Manage account specific paperflite landing pages for prospect accounts

Discovery Support & Insight Capture

  • Participate in early discovery calls (typically led by the AVP) to gather essential account context, pain points, and opportunity signals.
  • Take clear, structured notes and capture the information required to satisfy discovery-stage exit criteria.
  • Conduct light pre-call research to support AVP preparation and call strategy.

Sales Enablement & Collateral Preparation

  • Create v1 slideware or call prep materials using approved templates and automation tools for Qualify and Discovery conversations.

Qualifications

Experience & Skills

  • 2–5 years in business development, inside sales, account development, sales support, or SDR roles — preferably in B2B enterprise software, healthcare, or complex technical sales environments.

About Melita

Melita is an HR, Benefits, and Payroll outsourcing company, serving and building lasting relationships with small and mid-sized employers in the U.S. and abroad. We were founded over 30 years ago on a simple principle: to help our clients succeed by innovating, serving, and supporting their Human Resources, Employee Benefits, and Payroll needs. As a results-driven organization, we hold ourselves accountable for our promises, and we celebrate the successes of our clients. We live by a set of shared values that drive everything we do, and we are known for our high-integrity approach to building relationships with our clients and partners.

About the Role

This is a fully remote position. The People Operations Coordinator serves as HR liaison between Melita Group and its client organizations. Acting as a trusted partner and subject matter expert, this role delivers comprehensive HR operational support across the full employee lifecycle—from new client implementation through ongoing employee administration—responsible for executing onboarding and offboarding functions on behalf of clients.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in HRIS platforms (ADP, Paylocity, Rippling), employment compliance, and client relationship management, and is adept at balancing high-touch client service with scalable, process-driven execution.

Primary Responsibilities

    Primary Responsibilities

    Client Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the People Operations contact for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead and facilitate regularly scheduled client meetings, following structured agendas and ensuring all open HR Ops items are addressed and tracked to resolution.
  • Proactively identify HR risks or service gaps and escalate appropriately to leadership.

    • New Client Implementation

  • Partner with the People Operations Manager in new client HR Workflows & Communications planning meetings.
  • Participate in all phases of client implementation, ensuring HR operational readiness.
  • Develop and customize client-specific HR templates (offer letters, onboarding checklists, policy acknowledgments, termination notices, etc.).
  • Oversee the collection and organization of existing client I-9 documentation; coordinate audit and transfer of records to active employee folders.
  • Coordinate background check communication cadence, ensuring background check requirements are communicated prior to the HR Workflow meeting.

    • Employee Onboarding

  • Send onboarding communications to client new hires, including welcome emails and new hire orientation (NHO) instructions.
  • Enter and/or review new hire records transfer to HRIS, ensuring data accuracy across all required fields.
  • Ensure required pre-employment and new hire paperwork (direct deposit forms, tax withholding elections, policy acknowledgments) is collected timely.
  • Conduct FLSA assessments to determine exempt/non-exempt status for each new hire.
  • Assess visa status for eligibility of tax treaty exemptions (F-1, J-1, M-1, Q-1, Q-2) and coordinate with relevant parties to obtain this information early in the process.
  • Monitor and continuously improve the onboarding workflow, including evaluation of NHO software platforms and collaboration with the Benefits team on benefits orientation content.
  • Coordinate new hire orientation scheduling and logistics, for client new hires.
  • Ensure New-hires receive state-mandated notifications.
  • Refresh the New Hire Orientation (NHO) deck annually or upon significant policy/benefit changes.

    • Employee Offboarding

  • Develop and maintain process documentation for all termination types (voluntary and involuntary), leveraging the Melita knowledge base where applicable.
  • Partner closely with the client HR team throughout the involuntary termination process; maintaining clear and timely communication at each step.
  • Ensure compliant separation documentation is prepared and executed.
  • Coordinate final pay information and confirm final paycheck issuance in accordance with applicable state law.
  • Confirm benefits termination dates and coordinate any rollover or continuation elections.
  • Complete and submit state unemployment insurance separation documentation (e.g., EDD forms).

    • HR Compliance

  • Maintain and update HRIS home pages with current compliance-related information.
  • Conduct semi-annual minimum wage audits and recommend corrective actions where applicable.
  • Partner with Compliance Specialist to coordinate EEO-1-;VETS 4212, and California Pay Data reporting

    • Employee & Client Change Management

  • Process and/or review employee data changes in ADP and Salesforce, including hire date corrections, manager updates, department transfers, and time & attendance adjustments.
  • Remind employees of tax election requirements when relocating to a new state; coordinate updates accordingly.
  • Assess and communicate benefits enrollment implications resulting from qualifying life events or employment status changes.
  • Manage HR operational updates resulting from client legal company name changes or address changes (holiday schedules, NHO documentation, termination templates, etc.).

    • Employment Verification & Administrative Support

  • Complete employment verification requests (VOEs) accurately and within SLA.
  • Complete EDD unemployment claim forms and other state agency inquiries as assigned.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready employee and client records.

    • Oversight of HR Administrator (HRA) Service Delivery & Data Management

  • Serve as the day-to-day liaison and escalation point for HRA staff supporting assigned clients.
  • Learn and utilize our advance internal and external cloud-based software systems to support our clients and track work activities. Extensive use of Salesforce for our internal client management as well as a robust HR technology platform utilized by our clients.
  • Identify, escalate, and resolve service delivery issues in partnership with leadership.

Qualifications

    Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of HR operations, HR generalist, or HR services experience, preferably in a PEO, ASO, or HR outsourcing environment.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with ADP Workforce Now / Paylocity / Rippling (or equivalent HRIS) for new hire entry, employee changes, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of employment compliance requirements: I-9/E-Verify, FLSA, FMLA, COBRA, EEO-1, and state-specific regulations.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to facilitate meetings, present data, and manage competing priorities across multiple client accounts.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; comfort with HRIS systems.

    • Preferred

  • Experience with Salesforce (SF) or similar CRM used in an HR context.
  • PHR, SHRM-CP, or equivalent HR certification.

jobs.excerpt: We are recruiting for a growing payment processing business looking for an experienced Payment Operations Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day operations of the business and support its continued growth.
jobs.description:
We are recruiting for a growing payment processing business looking for an experienced Payment Operations Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day operations of the business and support its continued growth.

This is an important early-stage hire. We're looking for someone who understands how payment processing works and can take ownership of the operational side of the business — from merchant onboarding and transaction monitoring through to reconciliation, payment issues, reporting, and ongoing merchant support.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience working for a payment processor, merchant services provider, acquiring bank, fintech, payment gateway, or similar business.

This is not a purely administrative role. We're looking for someone who understands the payments ecosystem, can identify problems before they become bigger issues, and is comfortable building and improving processes as the company scales.

Key Responsibilities

Payment Operations

  • Monitor day-to-day payment processing activity and transaction flows
  • Monitor transaction success and failure rates and investigate unusual activity or processing issues
  • Identify payment exceptions, delays, discrepancies, and operational issues
  • Coordinate with processors, acquiring partners, banks, technology providers, and internal teams to resolve issues
  • Track outstanding payment issues through to resolution
  • Escalate critical payment incidents quickly and appropriately
  • Maintain clear records of operational issues and their resolutions

Merchant Onboarding & Account Management

  • Support the onboarding of new merchants from application through activation
  • Ensure merchant documentation and operational requirements are complete and accurate
  • Coordinate merchant account setup with processors and third-party providers
  • Manage ongoing merchant account changes, updates, and requests
  • Ensure a smooth handover from sales/onboarding into ongoing operations
  • Act as an operational point of contact for merchant-related issues

Reconciliation & Settlements

  • Assist with daily and periodic reconciliation of payment transactions
  • Review processor and settlement reports and identify discrepancies
  • Investigate differences between processor reports, bank activity, settlements, and internal records
  • Track outstanding settlement and funding issues
  • Assist with refunds, payouts, adjustments, and transaction corrections
  • Ensure financial and operational records remain accurate

Chargebacks, Disputes & Refunds

  • Monitor and manage chargeback and dispute workflows
  • Ensure required documentation and evidence is collected and submitted within deadlines
  • Track chargebacks through to resolution
  • Coordinate refunds and ensure they are processed accurately
  • Maintain accurate records of disputes, refunds, and payment exceptions
  • Identify recurring dispute or payment issues and flag opportunities to reduce them

Reporting & Analysis

  • Maintain regular payment operations reports
  • Track transaction volumes, approval rates, declines, chargebacks, refunds, and settlement activity
  • Identify trends and unusual activity within payment data
  • Prepare operational updates for management
  • Use Excel/Google Sheets or relevant reporting tools to analyse payment data
  • Help establish KPIs and operational dashboards as the business grows

Process & Operations Development

As an early hire within a growing payments business, you will be expected to help build the operational infrastructure, not simply follow an existing playbook.

You will:

  • Create and improve SOPs for recurring payment processes
  • Document merchant onboarding and operational workflows
  • Build checklists and controls to reduce errors
  • Identify repetitive manual processes that could be automated
  • Improve internal workflows as merchant and transaction volumes increase
  • Help establish escalation procedures for payment incidents
  • Continuously look for ways to make the operation more efficient and scalable

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with real-world payment processing experience rather than a general administrator who is willing to learn payments from scratch.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 2–5+ years of experience in payment processing, fintech, merchant services, acquiring, banking, or a closely related environment
  • Hands-on understanding of the payment lifecycle
  • Experience working with payment processors, gateways, acquirers, or merchant service providers
  • Experience with merchant onboarding and account management
  • Understanding of authorization, settlement, funding, refunds, and chargebacks
  • Experience with payment reconciliation and investigating transaction discrepancies
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously

Technical Knowledge

Candidates with experience working with platforms such as Stripe, Adyen, Worldpay, Fiserv, Global Payments, TSYS, PayPal, Checkout.com, Nuvei, or similar payment platforms would be highly desirable.

Specific platform experience is less important than having a genuine understanding of payment operations and being able to learn new systems quickly.

Knowledge of PCI DSS, payment security, fraud prevention, and payments compliance would also be advantageous.

Personality & Working Style

This role will suit someone who enjoys being the person who makes sure things actually get done.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Highly proactive and takes ownership
  • Naturally organised and process-driven
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Analytical and commercially minded
  • Calm when dealing with payment issues or operational problems
  • Comfortable communicating with merchants and external providers
  • Confident escalating problems when necessary
  • Naturally curious and willing to investigate rather than make assumptions
  • Comfortable working in a growing business where processes are still being developed
  • Someone who spots problems before they become fires

You shouldn't need to be told about the same problem twice.

The ideal candidate will look at an operational issue, understand what is happening, investigate the cause, communicate with the relevant parties, and see it through until it is resolved.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means the payment operation becomes increasingly reliable, organised, and scalable.

You will help ensure:

  • Merchants are onboarded efficiently
  • Transactions and settlements are accurately monitored
  • Payment issues are identified and resolved quickly
  • Reconciliations are accurate
  • Chargebacks and refunds are handled within required timelines
  • Merchants receive responsive operational support
  • Management has clear visibility into payment performance
  • Processes are documented and continuously improved
  • The business can increase transaction and merchant volumes without operational chaos

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a growing payments business at an early stage and have a meaningful impact on how the operation is built.

Rather than stepping into a highly siloed corporate payments role, you'll have the opportunity to help create the systems, processes, and operational standards that will support the business as it scales.

If you have genuine payment-processing experience, enjoy solving operational problems, and want to be part of building something from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence.
jobs.description:
Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence.

We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world.

Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space.

Why Appodeal?

At Appodeal, we’re more than just a company—we’re a team united by a common mission: Help people discover and grow their talents through products that enable successful mobile app businesses!

We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals.

Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too:

  • Continuous Learning and Growth: We are passionate about learning, growing personally, and building rewarding careers.
  • Making an Impact: We are committed to building a history-defining company that leaves a lasting impact on the mobile app industry.
  • Solving Exciting Challenges: We tackle complex problems every day, supported by a team of world-class professionals and mentors.
  • Enjoying the Journey: We believe in having fun while working toward our goals.

We are seeking an independent board director with deep experience operating ML-driven products and data platforms at scale.

This role is not focused on academic research or algorithm development. Instead, we are looking for a leader who has built organizations where data, experimentation, and machine learning directly drive product decisions, optimization, and revenue growth.

The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as:

  • building strong data science organizations;
  • designing data platforms and experimentation infrastructure;
  • integrating ML into product decision loops;
  • developing operating cultures built around data and experimentation;

This is a non-executive board position, not an operating role.

Appodeal is building a performance-driven technology platform powered by data and machine learning.

Our systems rely on:

  • large-scale data pipelines;
  • real-time decision systems;
  • automated optimization;
  • experimentation and model iteration.

The company operates an ecosystem including:

  • advertising infrastructure;
  • demand-side platform (DSP);
  • supply-side platform (SSP);
  • mobile game publishing and development.

Machine learning and data infrastructure are core to the company’s long-term competitive advantage.

Strategic Focus of the Role

The mission of this role is to strengthen the board’s ability to guide the company in building a world-class data and machine learning organization.

The director will contribute a perspective on:

  • structuring and scaling data science teams;
  • designing experimentation-driven product cultures;
  • building high-quality data platforms and infrastructure;
  • integrating ML systems into business decision processes;
  • best practices for data-driven product development;
  • organizational structures that allow ML systems to improve continuously.

This role focuses on how ML-driven companies operate, rather than on the underlying algorithms themselves.

Responsibilities

Board members are expected to:

  • Participate in quarterly board meetings;
  • Provide independent strategic guidance to the CEO and leadership team;
  • Contribute to discussions around data platform strategy and ML-driven product development;
  • Provide perspective on organizational structure for data science and ML teams;
  • Help evaluate major technical and infrastructure investments;
  • Share insight from companies where ML directly drives business outcomes;
  • Board members are not involved in day-to-day operations.

Ideal Background

We are looking for a technology or product leader who has built ML-driven product organizations where data science plays a central role in revenue generation and product optimization.

Prior board experience is welcome but not required.

What We Value

We are looking for individuals who bring:

  • deep experience running ML-driven product organizations:
  • strong operational judgment;
  • experience building data-driven engineering cultures;
  • an independent mindset;willingness to challenge assumptions constructively.

Time Commitment

Estimated commitment: approximately four weeks per year. This includes preparation and participation in board meetings as well as occasional strategic discussions with the leadership team.

With an outstanding product and a mission that excites and inspires, Appodeal offers a unique opportunity to make an impact while being part of an amazing team.

Join us and help shape the future of mobile app success!

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field.

You will have a deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) and Multi-Modal architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization, and a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: multi-modal data curation and alignment, strengthening baselines, and identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of cross-modal AI performance.

Responsibilities

  • Large-Scale Pre-Training: Conduct foundational pre-training for LLMs and Multi-Modal models (integrating text, vision, audio, or other modalities) on large, distributed servers equipped with multi-nodes & thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.

  • Architecture & Alignment Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures, tokenizers, and cross-modal alignment layers to enhance model intelligence and multi-modal understanding.

  • Data Strategy: Source, filter, and curate massive-scale textual and multi-modal datasets, establishing robust data pipelines for efficient pre-training.

  • Experimental Research: Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine training methodologies for optimal performance and token efficiency.

  • Optimization & Debugging: Investigate, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks in model efficiency, computational performance, and multi-modal alignment stability during long training runs.

  • System Scalability: Contribute to the advancement of distributed training systems to ensure seamless scalability and hardware efficiency on target platforms.

Head of Dynamics Business Applications Sale

Remote | Unlimited Holiday | Redefine how ERP sales actually works
Infinity Group are a innovative Microsoft Cloud Solution Partner based in the UK. We excel in providing award-winning IT Support, Digital Transformation, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Consultancy services.
With a robust team of over 180 professionals, we operate from offices in Tunbridge Wells and London Paddington. Our exceptional work has earned us the prestigious title of Microsoft Partner of the Year for Dynamics Business Central.

We are committed to the well-being and growth of our employees, and we prioritize continuous learning and development through fully funded training programs.
Our focus on people, expertise, and commitment to excellence underscores our mission to make a positive impact in the tech industry.

Role Overview:

As Head of Dynamics Business Applications Sales, you will lead the evolution of our sales approach from product-led to solution-led, customer-outcome focused engagement.

This is not about selling Dynamics 365. It’s about understanding where clients are today, where they need to get to, and designing the right journey to get them there.

You will be responsible for building a team that leads with curiosity, challenge, and insight - uncovering real business problems, aligning technology to outcomes, and positioning Infinity Group as a strategic partner rather than a software provider.

You will play a hands-on role in high-value opportunities, shaping how we diagnose customer needs, structure solutions, and win complex transformation deals.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own and evolve the end-to-end sales approach across Dynamics 365 (BC, CE, Power Platform)
  • Redefine how we qualify, shape, and win opportunities — anchored in outcomes, not products
  • Lead complex, high-value deals from early engagement through to close
  • Personally drive deep discovery with senior stakeholders (CEO, CFO, COO level)
  • Translate messy, unclear business problems into structured solution narratives
  • Ensure every proposal tells a clear story:
    • What’s broken
    • Why it matters
    • What changes
    • What it’s worth
    • Build a consistent way of working across the team:
      • How we run discovery
      • How we shape solutions
      • How we position value
      • Partner closely with Solution Architects and delivery to:
        • Bring credibility into the sales cycle early
        • Ensure what’s sold is real, deliverable, and scalable
        • Avoid the classic disconnect between sales and delivery
        • Improve win rates through:
          • Better qualification
          • Better positioning
          • Better thinking
          • Coach and develop a team that:
            • Leads with curiosity
            • Is comfortable challenging clients
            • Thinks commercially, not just tactically

The kind of problems you’ll solve

    You’ll constantly walk into situations where:

  • The client thinks they need a system — but doesn’t understand the real issue
  • Multiple stakeholders want different outcomes
  • Processes are unclear, undocumented, or broken
  • Technology is fragmented across the business
  • The commercial case isn’t fully formed

    • Your job is not to sell into that, Your job is to make sense of it.

    To:

  • Break down how the business actually works (not how it’s described)
  • Challenge assumptions where needed
  • Create clarity where there isn’t any
  • Shape a path forward that is both credible and commercially strong

What sets you apart

  • You don’t lead with “solutions” - you lead with understanding
  • You’re comfortable sitting in ambiguity and working towards clarity
  • You can challenge senior stakeholders without losing trust
  • You connect technology decisions to real business outcomes (growth, cost, risk)
  • You know how to structure complex conversations and keep control of them
  • You understand how business applications actually impact operations (not just IT)
  • You can balance:
    • Customer needs
    • Commercial reality
    • Delivery constraints
    • You spot weak opportunities early - and either reshape them or walk away
    • You care more about winning the right deals than winning more deals

Your impact:

  • You’ll define how sales works at Infinity Group - not just manage it
  • You’ll materially improve win rate and deal quality
  • You’ll shape how customers perceive us:

    • from “provider” → “partner”

  • You’ll reduce risk in what we sell by tightening alignment with delivery
  • You’ll build a team that clients actually trust

What it's like here:

  • Ambitious, but not political
  • High standards, but pragmatic
  • People who care about doing things properly — not just hitting numbers

    • You’ll get:

  • Real ownership of how sales evolves
  • Freedom to change things that don’t work
  • A team open to being challenged and developed
  • Direct access to leadership and influence over direction

Are you a theoretical mathematics expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are rapidly advancing, and their ability to handle rigorous proof-based reasoning depends on high-quality mathematical training data. With your advanced expertise, tomorrow’s AI can better understand abstraction, logic, measure theory, homotopy, and the deep structures of modern mathematics. That training data begins with you - your insight will help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for specialists with deep foundations in pure mathematics who can engage with advanced topics across probability theory, measure theory, real and functional analysis, optimization, abstract algebra, and category theory. Coupled with this deep foundation, we need each expert to have a normalized fluency in Lean 4, the proof assistant and programming language.

On a typical day, you will construct and evaluate complex proofs, substantiate the mathematical reasoning for correctness and rigor while identifying subtle conceptual or logical failures, and translate this material to successfully build in .lean syntax. You will also collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation frameworks, and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, enhancing the overall quality of our operations.

Candidates fluent in Lean 4 with an in-progress or freshly earned PhD or current PostDoc experience in pure mathematics are ideal. A strong command of core areas is required, and applicants should be comfortable with topics such as Markov’s and Chebyshev’s inequalities, Hoeffding bounds, convergence theorems, the Carathéodory extension theorem, the Riesz representation theorem, Banach–Alaoglu, Lax–Milgram, stochastic approximation, Van Kampen’s theorem, the Yoneda embedding, and representability in cohomology. Clear, metacognitive communication (explicitly articulating reasoning and proof strategies) is essential.

Ready to turn your Lean 4 fluidity and pure math expertise into the reasoning backbone of tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help teach the model that will support researchers, scientists, and engineers around the world.

Utilize medical information skills to identify, research, and critically evaluate medical literature to create responses to medical information inquiries.

Knowledge of FDA’s post-marketing adverse event reporting regulations and safety terminology. Ability to make accurate assessments regarding what information needs to be obtained and the level or depth of information to be collected.

ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

Senior Data Engineer

Overview

Rackner is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to lead the design, development, optimization, and operation of enterprise data pipelines and data platform components within the Microsoft Fabric environment.

The Senior Data Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership across data ingestion, transformation, platform administration, security, automation, and deployment activities. The Senior Data Engineer will also mentor Data Engineers and Associate Data Engineers, provide technical problem-solving support, and help establish engineering standards and best practices across data workstreams.

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise data ingestion pipelines, transformation logic, and data platform components within Microsoft Fabric

  • Configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft Fabric environments, including:
    • Tenant administration
    • Workspace architecture
    • Capacity management
    • Security configuration
    • Environment governance
  • Implement and maintain Bronze, Silver, and Gold medallion architecture layers
  • Develop data transformation processes incorporating schema validation, cleansing, normalization, enrichment, and reconciliation
  • Establish data quality monitoring, validation controls, automated testing, and alerting for pipeline and data-quality failures
  • Design and implement development, test, staging, and production environment separation

  • Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, and technical documentation for data platform implementation

  • Participate in architecture reviews and provide technical recommendations for data platform modernization and integration efforts
  • Mentor mid-level and Associate Data Engineers
  • Review technical implementations and provide guidance on pipeline design, code quality, performance, security, and maintainability
  • Provide senior-level technical problem-solving support for complex data engineering challenges

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience administering or configuring enterprise cloud data environments
  • Strong experience with Azure Data Factory or comparable data integration technologies
  • Strong SQL proficiency
  • Experience with Spark and PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation

  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Privileged Identity Management
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or comparable CI/CD platforms
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or comparable infrastructure-as-code technologies
  • Experience designing automated data quality monitoring and alerting
  • Experience supporting hybrid on-premises and cloud data environments
  • Experience implementing disaster recovery, rollback, and business continuity procedures for enterprise data platforms

About Rackner

jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Manager, Pricing Strategy & Market Intelligence

Revenue Operations | Reports to VP, Revenue Operations | Remote / Flexible

About the Role

Black Duck Software is looking for a Manager of Pricing Strategy & Market Intelligence to own how we price, package, and position our products in the market. This is a high-impact individual contributor role embedded in Revenue Operations, reporting to the VP of Revenue Operations and working in close partnership with Product, Product Marketing, and Finance.

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and market insight. You will own Black Duck's list pricing architecture, lead packaging decisions in collaboration with Product and Product Marketing and ensure that our pricing model is both margin-accretive and aligned with how customers actually want to buy. You will also serve as the company's primary source of competitive pricing intelligence and customer segmentation analysis — translating market signals into pricing and GTM recommendations that influence how we go to market.

This role works in close alignment with the Director of Sales Operations, particularly around deal desk. You will set the pricing architecture and policies that deal desk enforces at the transaction level — a clean handoff model that requires strong collaboration and clear boundaries of ownership.

The right candidate is analytically rigorous, commercially minded, and credible with senior stakeholders across Revenue, Product, and Finance. You are comfortable operating as an individual contributor while influencing decisions that affect the entire go-to-market organization.

What You'll Own

List Pricing Architecture & Governance

  • Own and maintain Black Duck's list pricing across all product lines, ensuring prices are internally consistent, margin-positive, and defensible in the market
  • Define and document pricing tiers, rate card structures, and discount floor policies that serve as the authoritative reference for Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance
  • Drive annual and ad hoc pricing reviews, synthesizing inputs from Finance (margin targets), Sales (field feedback), and Market Intelligence (competitive positioning) into clear pricing recommendations
  • Ensure pricing changes are communicated clearly and adopted consistently across the GTM organization, with appropriate lead time and enablement
  • Establish pricing governance processes that prevent unauthorized discounting while giving Sales the flexibility needed to compete effectively

Packaging Strategy

  • Partner with Product and Product Marketing to design and evolve packaging that maps to customer buying patterns, use case clusters, and willingness-to-pay signals
  • Analyze how Black Duck's current packaging performs in the market — where it wins, where it creates friction, and where it leaves revenue on the table — and translate that into concrete packaging recommendations
  • Evaluate alternative monetization models (e.g., per-developer seat, per-application, consumption-based, enterprise license) against customer preference data and competitive norms, and make data-driven recommendations on model structure
  • Collaborate with Finance to model the margin and revenue implications of packaging changes before they are implemented

Competitive Pricing Intelligence

  • Build and maintain a rigorous, ongoing view of how Black Duck's primary competitors — including Snyk, Veracode, Checkmarx, GitHub Advanced Security, and other emerging players — structure and position their pricing in the market
  • Track competitor packaging changes, pricing model shifts, promotional activity, and market positioning through primary and secondary research, field intelligence, and available third-party sources
  • Synthesize competitive pricing data into actionable guidance for Sales (how to position Black Duck's pricing in competitive deals) and for leadership (where our pricing model creates strategic risk or opportunity)
  • Develop and maintain a competitive pricing database and regular cadence of intelligence outputs — ensuring Sales leadership and Product have a reliable, current view of the competitive landscape

Customer Segmentation & ICP Refinement

  • Own Black Duck's customer segmentation framework, defining and maintaining the firmographic, technographic, and behavioral criteria that characterize our Ideal Customer Profile across segments
  • Analyze how pricing sensitivity, deal size, sales cycle length, and product adoption vary across customer segments — and use those findings to inform territory design, quota setting, and GTM prioritization
  • Identify patterns in how different customer cohorts (by industry, size, geography, or tech stack) price and budget for AppSec tooling, and translate those patterns into recommendations on how Black Duck prices and packages for each segment
  • Partner with Marketing and Sales leadership to ensure ICP definitions are operationalized in Salesforce and reflected in lead scoring, outbound targeting, and account prioritization

Pricing vs. Customer Buying Model Analysis

  • Conduct ongoing analysis of the gap between how Black Duck prices and how customers prefer to buy — identifying friction points in our commercial model that contribute to deal stalls, discount pressure, or competitive losses
  • Survey field intelligence, closed/lost data, and renewal patterns to understand where our pricing model creates buyer friction and where it aligns with customer budget and procurement norms
  • Benchmark Black Duck's pricing model structure against how comparable AppSec and DevSecOps vendors go to market, and develop recommendations for model evolution based on those findings
  • Present findings to senior leadership with clear recommendations, supporting data, and an explicit view of trade-offs — not just analysis, but a point of view

Cross-Functional & Strategic Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary pricing and market intelligence resource for Sales leadership, providing deal-level guidance on pricing strategy for complex or strategic opportunities
  • Partner with Finance to ensure list pricing supports target gross margin thresholds and that pricing model changes are modeled for revenue impact before implementation
  • Contribute to annual planning processes by providing market-informed inputs on pricing assumptions, segment opportunity sizing, and competitive dynamics
  • Build pricing and intelligence tools, templates, and dashboards that make your analysis accessible and actionable for Sales, Finance, and Product stakeholders
  • Operate with a strong publication and communication cadence — your value is only realized if stakeholders can act on what you produce

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in pricing strategy, revenue strategy, product pricing, or a closely related function within enterprise SaaS or software
  • Demonstrated ownership of list pricing — including rate card design, tier structure, and pricing governance — not just analysis in support of pricing decisions
  • Experience developing competitive intelligence programs with a direct connection to commercial outcomes, not purely research or analyst functions
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to build pricing models, margin analyses, and segmentation frameworks from scratch in Excel or equivalent tools
  • Proven ability to translate quantitative analysis and market research into clear, executive-ready recommendations with a defensible point of view
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Finance, and Sales in a collaborative but structured model
  • Comfort operating as a high-impact individual contributor — you are the function, not the manager of the function, and you take ownership accordingly

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or application security markets — or in a comparable technical B2B software environment with complex buyer dynamics
  • Familiarity with software composition analysis, SAST, DAST, or related AppSec product categories and their competitive landscapes
  • Experience working within a Revenue Operations or Finance-aligned structure, as distinct from a Sales-embedded or Product-embedded pricing role
  • Exposure to monetization model design — evaluating and recommending between seat-based, consumption-based, application-based, or enterprise license structures
  • Proficiency in Salesforce for data pulls and segmentation analysis; familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) a plus

Leadership & Behavioral Profile

  • Analytically rigorous with strong intellectual honesty — you distinguish between what the data shows and what you think, and you are transparent about both
  • Commercially credible — you understand how enterprise software is sold, not just how it is priced, and that context shapes the quality of your recommendations

  • Effective communicator with the ability to present complex pricing and market analysis to senior audiences clearly and without unnecessary hedging
  • Collaborative but opinionated — you work well with Product, Finance, and Sales while being willing to advocate for a position when the data supports it

Black Duck Software is a leading cybersecurity company helping organizations identify, manage, and remediate open source vulnerabilities within their applications. We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence – presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries: rather than allowing the poverty gap to expand, low-income countries have an opportunity to leapfrog development milestones with AI-powered innovations. Incubated at Evidence Action, we’re launching The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled ‘big bets’ to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

We will operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to the benefits of AI for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We will create “public good,” open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we’re scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.

We are led by CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action’s track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.

Our Approach

We’re building an AI-native organization focused on designing solutions to reach tens or hundreds of millions of individuals living in poverty. We will focus both on delivering near-term, tractable direct impact as well as assisting governments to grow capacity and build enabling environments for the AI for Good ecosystem, including:

  • Launching AI-enabled interventions to impact tens or hundreds of millions, such as delivering AI-enabled forecasts to smallholder farmers to improve yields and earnings, leveraging AI to dramatically improve medical diagnosis and treatment, implementing frontier systems to identify and mitigate disease outbreaks, or putting personalized AI tutors into the hands of students to drive reductions to system-level educational attainment gaps. When relevant, we will partner with leading AI labs to shape technical offerings, including adapting for underrepresented languages, bandwidth constraints, etc.
  • Partnering with governments in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) to drive regulatory changes, policy, and investments necessary to unlock beneficial use cases at national scale, while proactively mitigating the downside risks of AI.

Building on our recent Cross-Sector Analysis of near and medium-term AI opportunities in LMICs, we are advancing the highest-scoring interventions through a rigorous vetting process, including evidence reviews, cost-effectiveness analyses, risk assessments, and early operational/technical scoping. We are excited about the opportunity to deliver AI-enabled weather forecasting for smallholder farmers, and are now running deeper analysis on opportunities in global health.

Requirements

Who You Are

You might be a strong fit for the AI Access Initiative team if you bring an ownership mindset and thrive in fast-moving, ambitious environments. Ideal candidates take initiative, are comfortable putting structure around ambiguity, and focus on outcomes not outputs. We’re especially excited about hiring builders who problems, enjoy creating new systems from the ground up and thinking creatively about some of the world's hardest problems

What the Sr. Salesforce Architect does at Worldwide

The Senior Salesforce Architect serves as the enterprise design authority and technical owner for the Salesforce platform and its tightly coupled Certinia ecosystem, responsible for evolving the commercial technology stack to support the Sales, Marketing, and Sales Operations organizations. This role provides architectural leadership across the lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-project lifecycles, ensuring Salesforce solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to measurable business outcomes while integrating reliably with the broader enterprise application and data landscape.

The Senior Salesforce Architect partners closely with the IT Commercial Business Partner as the primary technology advisor to the Sales Operations team and with the Certinia system team on shared objects, integration patterns, and data flows that span Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Professional Services Automation (PSA), and the enterprise data warehouse. This role owns the multi-year Salesforce roadmap and sets enterprise development standards for Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, Platform Events, and Flows.

It embeds AI-driven capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud, and emerging generative AI, into the commercial technology stack while managing the product backlog, overseeing service desk support, and providing direct leadership to a team of administrators and developers. Success in this role requires deep expertise in Salesforce platform architecture, strong working knowledge of Certinia, command of commercial processes, fluency in AI-driven platform capabilities, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into governed, high-impact technology solutions within a complex, global enterprise environment.
